title: trachelospermum fragrans
intro: Trachelospermum fragrans, commonly known as Star Jasmine, is a flowering evergreen climber native to Asia, known for its fragrant white flowers and ability to thrive in a variety of environments. The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including reducing stress and anxiety, improving sleep quality, and boosting the immune system. Trachelospermum fragrans is believed to have therapeutic actions such as sedation, antispasmodic, and anti-inflammatory effects, which may contribute to its medicinal properties. The bioactive constituents of Trachelospermum fragrans include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which have been identified as responsible for its therapeutic effects.
